definitions.quote: Hearing: A formally convened meeting to consider alleged cases of academic misconduct.
Unfair Means: This is another term for academic misconduct or academic malpractice.
Plagiarism may be defined as the representation of another person’s work, without acknowledgement of the source, as the student’s own for the purposes of satisfying
Collusion is where two or more students collaborate to produce a piece of work in order to both/all gain advantage.
Fabrication of data refers to the falsification of data (either qualitative or quantitative), through invention or amendment
Commissioning – also known as “contract cheating” involves requesting another person or using AI to complete an assessment, or contribute to an assessment
Theft of work – submitting another’s work as the suspected student’s own, either in whole or in part, without that student’s permission.
